title: Mosquito Trap My Butt!
text:
Mosquito Trap My Butt!. I bought these because another site rated them as the best for mosquitos. Here we are in east Texas on the McKinney Bayou where the first mosquito tagged both Adam and Eve, and we ain't caught a mosquito one, yet my pet armadillo is damn near anemic from them. And they won't stick to the window much less a mosquito.

Seriously, these things are worthless.
